detail.fixture_type: synthetic two-band Haldane tight-binding model with exact HR Fourier mapping; not an ab-initio W90Flow export

mapping_report.scientific_scope: exact synthetic two-band tight-binding mapping only; not ab-initio reproduction and not SI FDR normalization

representation.Fourier_convention: H(k)=sum_R H(R) exp(+i 2 pi k_frac dot R)
representation.cell_gauge_relation: H_cell=U^dagger H_source U; U=diag(1, exp(-i k dot delta1))
representation.position_embedding: Wannier-center difference wc_B-wc_A=delta1 restores physical NN bond vectors in dH/dk

mapping_report.checks_summary: The Haldane source-gauge Hamiltonian and its first/second k derivatives match the generated HR representation after the explicit cell-gauge transform and Wannier-center embedding.
limitations: C atoms in POSCAR are a synthetic C3 marker orbit, not physical atoms or active orbitals; the POSCAR is symmetry metadata for this effective model only.
quality.json passed=true denotes this exact synthetic mapping check only, not an ab-initio/W90Flow quality certification.
Numerical energy values are labeled eV and length values Å to exercise the NLO parser; this does not by itself establish absolute SI response conversion from the FDR's hbar=q=t1=1 convention.
The current NLO workflow's response kernel is diagonal-TBA; only Hamiltonian and position-dressed derivatives are checked here, not equivalence of the FDR and NLO response formulas.

nlo_kernel_validation.interpretation: Actual NLO reader/Fourier kernel was exercised without running a response calculation.
limitations: The point-group check depends on local spglib version and synthetic marker POSCAR.
No shift-current spectrum or FDR response comparison was run.
